title: An incomplete referral stops with an Ownership Gap and no recruitment

persona.name: Morgan
persona.brief: Explain that risk owns the block rule but that you do not know the person's name or contact details.

mission.objective: Learn who decides whether a high-risk account block can be removed.
mission.desired_outcome: Identify the decision rule and owner, or preserve the ownership gap honestly.
mission.data_use: The Investigator will review the finding before changing account-block handling.

investigation_results.knowledge_gap: Who owns removal of a high-risk account block and what rule do they use?
investigation_results.why_it_matters: Customer operations must not invent or bypass a risk decision.
investigation_results.relevant_context: Customer operations can see blocks but cannot remove them.
investigation_results.sufficient_evidence: The owner and rule are supported, or what remains unresolved and the best available owner description are explicit.

turns.sourceQuestion: How do you decide whether a high-risk account block can be removed?

answer.text: That decision belongs to someone in risk, not customer operations. I do not know their name, contact details, or the rule they use.
